description: This Java class 'ThingEnforcementIdCacheLoader' implements an asynchronous cache loader that retrieves entity ID relations for authorization purposes by querying a shard region proxy using actors. It handles responses related to 'Thing' entities, extracting relevant IDs and revisions for cache entries.

classes.name: ThingEnforcementIdCacheLoader
classes.description: A cache loader that asynchronously loads entity ID and revision information for 'Thing' entities, for use in authorization. It communicates with a shard region proxy actor to retrieve data and processes the response to extract relevant IDs and revisions.

methods.name: ThingEnforcementIdCacheLoader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache loader with the ask timeout and the shard region proxy actor, setting up command creation and response handling functions.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Asynchronously loads cache entries for a given key using the delegate actor cache loader.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Processes the response received from the shard region proxy, extracting the 'Thing' or 'Policy' related ID and revision info, or handling access denial.

methods.name: badThingResponse
methods.description: Helper method that creates a supplier for an exception when the response does not conform to expected types.
